comprehensive_profile_name_with_rules.sql:
SELECT fhir_resources.id, fhir_resources.user_id, fhir_resources.resource_type, fhir_resources.ehr_resource_id, fhir_resources.ehr_connection_id, fhir_resources.data, fhir_resources.ehr_provider, fhir_resources.ehr_provider_id, fhir_resources.ehr_patient_id, fhir_resources.last_synced_at, fhir_resources.created_at, fhir_resources.updated_at, CASE WHEN coalesce(fhir_resources.data ->> %(data_1)s ILIKE %(param_1)s, %(coalesce_1)s) THEN %(param_2)s WHEN coalesce((fhir_resources.data ->> %(data_1)s) ~ %(param_3)s, %(coalesce_2)s) THEN %(param_4)s WHEN coalesce((fhir_resources.data ->> %(data_1)s) = %(param_5)s AND CAST(fhir_resources.ehr_provider AS VARCHAR) = %(param_6)s, %(coalesce_3)s) THEN %(param_7)s END AS exclusion_reason 
FROM fhir_resources 
WHERE fhir_resources.user_id = %(user_id_1)s AND CAST(fhir_resources.resource_type AS VARCHAR) = %(param_8)s AND jsonb_extract_path_text(fhir_resources.data, %(jsonb_extract_path_text_1)s) = %(jsonb_extract_path_text_2)s ORDER BY jsonb_extract_path_text(fhir_resources.data, %(jsonb_extract_path_text_3)s) DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_9)s
